description: Resolve a track to its ID and deep link on every supported platform: Spotify, Apple Music, Tidal, Beatport, Discogs, MusicBrainz, YouTube. Identify the track by exactly one of: SonoVault id, ISRC, or any platform's ID.

discogs_id.description: Discogs track key: release ID plus track position, e.g. '2844-A'. A bare release ID matches nothing.
